games.note: Contra x Tetris: run-and-gun on falling-block terrain. Shoot blocks to break them, clear rows to delete the floor, and do not get crushed.
games.title: Block Commando

games.note: Paperboy x Road Rash: delivery courier combat racing. Throw papers into mailboxes, punch adjacent rivals, dodge the cars.
games.title: Paper Rash

games.note: Bionic Commando x Ninja Gaiden: hold Z to fire the grapple at rings and swing, release to launch, slash with X.
games.title: Grapple Ninja

games.note: Kung-Fu Master x Punch-Out!!: side-scroll grunts, then a 1-on-1 counter-boxing boss. Dodge, block, and jab when he is stunned.
games.title: Kung Fu Knockout

games.note: Excitebike x Skate or Die: 4-rider dirt downhill with heat-managed turbo and ramp air tricks (tabletop, bar spin, 360). Place, time and trick scoring with a persistent high score.
games.title: BMX Downhill Rush

games.note: Moth's third Maze Wrecker, built on the other AI's shared gamekit (Cherie 2026-10-30): the cabinet lattice maze at night — same pellets, bricks and three foreman ghosts, but the hammer is a weapon now: swing at a ghost to STUN him for 3 seconds (+50). Tighter 135-second seal. Bot-verified clear, stun probe-verified.
games.title: Maze Wrecker: Night Shift

games.note: Painted HD edition of the hive shooter: same rules and bot, painted sprites, baked room and a real lighting pass. Tier 2 of the Vampire Metroid editions (gamepress tier system, merged to main 2026-10-30).
games.title: Vampire Metroid HD

games.note: HD+ game-feel edition: hit flash, squash, knockback, floating damage numbers, camera lean and a boss-death push-in. Same rules as the pixel edition — parity-checked.
games.title: Vampire Metroid HD+

games.note: HD Art edition: hand-drawn SVG characters on a skeletal rig, WebGL bloom and grade pass. Same rules — parity-checked.
games.title: Vampire Metroid HD Art

games.note: HD Lux edition: SVG environment, shader lights, haze and embers over the HD Art rig. Same rules — parity-checked.
games.title: Vampire Metroid HD Lux

games.note: HD Close edition: tall full-screen layout, follow camera, bigger characters and a 360-degree analog touch pad. Intentionally differs: no pause, analog movement.
games.title: Vampire Metroid HD Close

games.note: HD World edition: painted-style SVG rig characters (hero, three zombie types, elite, queen boss) in a dressed lab world. Same rules — parity-checked. Painted raster art drops in via the gamepress painted-art brief.
games.title: Vampire Metroid HD World

games.note: 3D spike: the same Vampire Metroid sim rendered in Three.js. Experimental tier from the gamepress tier system.
games.title: Vampire Metroid 3D

games.note: One-round arcade 1v1 on the cabinet's native per-frame 8-bit rig — left/right move, down blocks, up jumps, Z punches, X kicks. KO the CPU or lead on health at 45 seconds.
games.title: Street Round

games.note: One-round arcade fight with a full special-move list on the native 8-bit rig: fireball (236+P), rising punch (623+P), spin kick (214+K), plus the second fighter's charge moves (hold back, then forward + P; hold down, then up + K). Add ?char=guile to play the other fighter. Six-button keyboard layout (U I O punches, J K L kicks); Z/X are the medium punch/kick shortcuts and the touch buttons. Move test 48/48.
games.title: Ryu vs Guile

games.note: The same fight in a 16-bit look: vector-drawn fighters with shaded limbs, then a posterised 256x224 pixel pass. Same moves and controls as the 8-bit edition (add ?char=guile to play the other fighter). Six-button keyboard layout (U I O punches, J K L kicks); Z/X are the medium punch/kick shortcuts and the touch buttons.
games.title: Ryu vs Guile 16-bit

games.note: Four-lane ragdoll sprint: tap Z then X alternately to run, Up jumps hurdles and mud — trip and you flop face-first. Beat three CPU runners over 100 m.
games.title: Floppy Race

games.note: Fighter training room: deal 150 damage to a standing dummy within 40 seconds using the full move list — fireball 236+P, rising punch 623+P, spin kick 214+K. Same moves as the main fight.
games.title: Training Dojo

games.note: Three fights in a row against stronger CPUs, and health does not refill between fights.
games.title: Tournament Ladder

games.note: One armoured boss who takes 75% damage — and his AI gets harder when he is hurt. Full move list.
games.title: Boss Rush

games.note: Four-direction beat-'em-up on the fighter rig: arrows walk, Z punches, X kicks. Clear three waves and the boss.
games.title: Street Brawl

games.note: Sumo on the fighter rig: tap Z then X alternately to shove — first one out of the ring loses.
games.title: Sumo Shove

games.note: Dodgeball with fireballs: Z throws low, X throws high; jump to dodge low balls, duck to dodge high ones. Five hearts each.
games.title: Fireball Dodgeball

games.note: Rock-paper-scissors grappling: Z strike, X guard, Up throw. Strike beats throw, throw beats guard, guard beats strike — and the CPU repeats itself half the time, so read it.
games.title: Grapple Duel

games.note: Hold the locker room against the dead for 45 seconds. Left/right move, Z or X fires. Every frame is drawn live by the cabinet's native 8-bit rig — no sprite assets.
games.title: Locker Room Last Stand

games.note: Fight through three dungeon rooms. Arrows move, hold Z or X to throw axes (auto-aims). Keys open doors, bone piles spawn monsters, food refills your draining health.
games.title: Crypt Gauntlet

games.note: Pick the plane, tank or archer at the start (left/right, then Z); the computer plays the other two. Loop-the-loop dodges (plane: press Z and X together), shoot red waves for POW, and beat the boss bomber.
games.title: Skyfire 42

games.note: The same Skyfire 42 mission with high-end shaded 8-bit sprites: pick plane, tank or archer (left/right, then Z) and the computer plays the other two. Plane: Z+X together loops. Beat the boss bomber.
games.title: Skyfire 42: High-End 8-Bit

games.note: The same Skyfire 42 mission as a painted HD world: sea, islands, harbours, clouds and lit explosions. Pick plane, tank or archer (left/right, then Z); the computer plays the other two. Plane: Z+X together loops.
games.title: Skyfire 42: Painted
